headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google VP hints at increased price for the upcoming Pixel 11. Rising RAM costs, fueled by AI data centers, are a likely cause. The price adjustment is not unexpected given market conditions.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Musician and journalist Oli Freke is known for his deep dives into synthesizers and music theory. He's authored a book tracing synth evolution from 1963-1995. Freke revealed a surprising personal spending priority: a quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering's distinctive grooveboxes, blending instruments and art, are on sale. These devices allow real-time song production with unique designs. A significant 30 percent discount is available across a wide range of their offerings.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has filed a lawsuit against Amazon. Amazon is accused of illegally poaching key employees, including a senior marketing VP. Warner Bros. claims Amazon is "riding on the coattails" of established Hollywood firms.

headline: Winston Duke Confirms That Yes, He Really Did Improvise That Iconic Line In Black Panther
summary: Winston Duke confirmed he improvised a famous comedic line in Black Panther. The line, spoken by his character M'Baku, became instantly iconic. Duke's off-the-cuff delivery added a memorable moment to the film.

headline: 'I Would Stay at That Haunted Inn' — Widow's Bay Cast and Crew Are Just as Attached to the Island as the Rest of Us | Comic Con 2026
summary: The cast and crew of Apple TV's Widow's Bay held their first Hall H panel at Comic-Con. They discussed the show's breakout success and shared their attachment to its setting. Stars expressed fondness for the fictional island, even its "haunted inn."

headline: The 4 Biggest Mysteries From Marvel's Comic-Con Panel | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel left fans with several major unanswered questions. Mysteries include T'Challa's adult son and Ryan Reynolds' Ghost Rider role. The panel also raised new questions about Deadpool's future.

headline: Hayley Atwell Explains That Trailer With Steve Rogers Holding a Baby
summary: Marvel star Hayley Atwell addressed the mysterious trailer showing Steve Rogers with a baby. Her explanation only deepened the confusion surrounding the scene. Fans are still left speculating about the context and meaning of the image.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Andy Burnham stated he's willing to challenge Trump if it benefits Britain's interests. He confirmed a positive initial conversation with the US president. Burnham emphasized the importance of defending the national interest.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: New Prime Minister Andy Burnham ruled out an early general election. He stated he would honor the manifesto people voted for. Burnham made the remarks in an exclusive interview with Laura Kuenssberg.

headline: Police investigate donations by Tice company to Reform UK
summary: Police are investigating donations made by Richard Tice's company, Britain Means Business. The company made two £250,000 donations to Reform UK before the 2024 election. Tice is the deputy leader of Reform UK.

headline: What Love Island tells us about the changing face of dating
summary: Love Island offers insights into evolving British dating culture. The show highlights shifting dynamics, like women increasingly making the first move. It serves as a cultural mirror for modern relationship trends.
